mainWorker.name: brclio-xhs-downloader
mainWorker.role: Node parsing, image/video download, account/admin/health and dispatch to the Python engine.

pythonWorker.name: brclio-xhs-python
pythonWorker.role: Existing separate Python parsing/image/video runtime, reached through the private PYTHON_API service binding.
pythonWorker.whyNotRedeployed: Its runtime source did not change. The already deployed version is retained and was exercised by real production Python parsing and image download.
pythonWorker.whyKeep: Deleting it would break the Python engine paths used by the website and clients. Lack of a public zone route is intentional for this internal service.

requestFlow: Official domain reaches the Pages custom-domain entry.
Pages serves static files; /api/* and /admin* invoke its gateway.
Gateway calls the main Worker through APP.
Python API requests call the existing Python Worker through PYTHON_API.

zoneRoutes.meaning: No zone-route entry does not mean the Worker is unused. This deployment receives requests through Pages/service bindings; the private Python Worker intentionally has no public workers.dev endpoint.
zoneRoutes.auditBoundary: This coverage audit reads tracked configuration and the separate verified deployment/binding metadata; it did not perform an additional zone-routes API query.

limits: Service availability and binding preservation do not guarantee every business flow or future upstream response.
